statements.status_notes: PostgreSQL fixed CVE-2026-6470 (PostgreSQL fails to check type USAGE privilege) in 16.15 on the PostgreSQL 16 branch: https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-6470/ lists 16.15 as the fixed release for major version 16 (versions before 16.15 are affected), and the 16.15 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/16.15/, list this CVE. The fix is three commits on the REL_16_STABLE branch tagged Security: CVE-2026-6470, all in the REL_16_15 release tag and not in REL_16_14: https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/24855357c32faa0acfdc9da0a229d969d79ae124 (USAGE on the subtype in CREATE TYPE AS RANGE), https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/7ce056b1798b81a287ae00e2c06f210fd0e59be2 (USAGE on types used by stored expressions) and https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/7a761fe408d51b43e42393c4b4fbcff9462229fa (USAGE on the composite type in ALTER TABLE OF). The DHI postgresql16 packages for Alpine 3.23 are built from Alpine's postgresql16 APKBUILD, https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/859fa0795e895af033fab32094a83301f2b4d8ff/community/postgresql16/APKBUILD, which builds the upstream PostgreSQL release tarball; none of the patches it applies touch the files this fix changes. It lists CVE-2026-6470 under its 16.15-r0 secfixes. We checked the postgres server binary, /usr/libexec/postgresql16/postgres, in every postgresql16 build published for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI package repository as of 2026-11-28, on both x86_64 and aarch64 (package checksums verified against the package index): 16.13-r0 and 16.14-r0 report PostgreSQL 16.13 and 16.14 and are affected, while 16.15-r0 and 16.16-r0 report PostgreSQL 16.15 and 16.16 and carry the fix. As a check, the server binary exports the functions CheckUsageOnTypesInExpr and CheckUsageOnTypesInSingleRelExpr, which the second commit adds, in 16.15-r0 and 16.16-r0 on both architectures, and the same file in 16.13-r0 and 16.14-r0 does not. 16.15-r0 is the first published build that carries the fix.
